principles: Preserve and reuse credible career capital instead of restarting experienced professionals from zero.
Separate awareness from demonstrated capability; courses alone are not proof of job readiness.
Prioritize the smallest set of AI capabilities that materially changes target-role readiness.
Require evidence artifacts such as prototypes, evaluations, PRDs, architecture diagrams, or case studies.
Sequence learning so that concepts are immediately reinforced through hands-on application.
Treat interview positioning as the packaging of demonstrated capability, not a substitute for it.

experienced_product_to_ai_product.positioning: Retain product, domain, stakeholder, and delivery experience; add AI product judgement, technical literacy, evaluation, and evidence.
phases: AI use-case discovery and problem framing
AI lifecycle, risk, guardrails, and monitoring
One working AI product plus AI PM artifacts
anti_patterns: Restarting with a generic beginner programming curriculum when existing product experience is strong
Jumping into advanced multi-agent frameworks before understanding model/tool/evaluation fundamentals

experienced_engineer_to_ai_engineering.positioning: Reuse software-engineering discipline while closing ML/LLM application, retrieval, evaluation, and production AI gaps.
phases: Production-style portfolio system and interview positioning
anti_patterns: Treating prompt engineering alone as AI engineering
Building notebooks only without deployable application evidence

experienced_architect_to_ai_architecture.positioning: Reuse architecture, integration, data, security, and stakeholder skills while adding LLM-system design, evaluation, and AI governance depth.
phases: Architecture review narrative and interview positioning
anti_patterns: Learning frameworks without architecture trade-off understanding
Ignoring data quality and permission boundaries
Presenting diagrams without working validation or evaluation evidence

fallback.positioning: Preserve credible prior experience, identify the minimum AI capability delta for the target role, and require evidence before claiming readiness.
